# StatVault

> Session 139 — "Full NFL history: the franchise encyclopedia + every coach ever" (founder /goal arc, pushed direct to main). Directive: every player/coach/team across the ENTIRE NFL history with verified stats from legal/free sources weighted via the Oracle — NOT capped at 1999. Built the franchise crown jewel: (1) curated franchises.json (32 franchises: founding, city, approx metro population, past names/relocations, full Super Bowl + pre-SB championship ledger). (2) Full-history team records via Wikipedia (ingest-wikipedia-franchise-seasons.mjs -> franchise-seasons-historical.json, 2,224 seasons 1920->2025, all 32 franchise-complete season-list pages, facts-only; fixed dagger-tagged championship-row drop + WAS no-league-column; spot-verified CHI 1985/MIA 1972 14-0/NE 2007 16-0/GB 1962 Lombardi/IND 1958 Ewbank/DET 2008 0-16 exactly). (3) build-franchises.mjs + pure franchise-core.mjs (+13 node tests) -> franchise-history.json fusing full-history records (Wikipedia) + per-category team box stats (nflverse 1999+) + exact 1999+ playoff W-L (games.csv) + best-players-in-franchise-history (team-only) + curated identity/titles. (4) /teams/[sport]/[team] rebuilt into the full franchise encyclopedia, backend-dark-safe (was current-roster-only + 404'd backend-dark): identity, championship ledger, all-time + playoff records, best players (team-only stats), year-by-year team stats, live roster when reachable. GB 815-608-36 (.571) 1921-2025 / 13 titles; NE Brady 74,573 team pass yds + 33-13 playoffs; LAR merges STL+LAR. (5) Full-history coaches: aggregateCoachesFromHistory (+3 node tests) lifts coaches 153->417 across all of NFL history with exact records + SB/championship counts (Shula 328-156-6, Halas 318-148-31, Belichick 302-165/6SB, Lombardi 96-34-6, Landry, Noll, Walsh, Lambeau). Verified: tsc + eslint clean, Jest 1157/1157 (189 suites), 26 node:test cores, validator 0 errors, route-graph 0 broken links, coherence 0 contradictions. Honest limits (labeled in-UI): per-category box stats + best-players are 1999+; pre-1999 = record/finish/coach/postseason only; metro pop approximate.

## Identity
- Slug: statvault
- Medium: platform
- Audience: internal
- Vault status: FORGE
- Health: green
- Live: https://statvault.org

## Current focus
Session 139 — "Full NFL history: the franchise encyclopedia + every coach ever" (founder /goal arc, pushed direct to main). Directive: every player/coach/team across the ENTIRE NFL history with verified stats from legal/free sources weighted via the Oracle — NOT capped at 1999

## Next milestone
Players full history: apply the same full-history fusion to player profiles (universe present, pre-1999 season grids thin) via the Wikipedia player ingester — the player half of the directive. Then route the curated/Wikipedia franchise+coach facts through the Oracle source-credibility/triangulation layer (founder ask: sources 'weighted and verified through our Oracle')
